name: Aether
shortDescription: 11 tools: financial_search, transcript_search, marketplace partners/proxy, seller signup + publish for SEC filings and earnings transcripts.
longDescription: Aether MCP Server — financial-vertical agent search engine. Hybrid SEC filings (10-K/10-Q/8-K) + earnings transcripts retrieval over 1.4M+ chunks, plus a two-sided marketplace for third-party data. Tools: financial_search, transcript_search, list_partners, partner_search, partner_proxy_search, seller_signup, seller_publish_document, seller_register_endpoint, seller_list_my_documents, seller_list_my_endpoints. Connect Claude, Cursor, Cline, or any MCP client.
